note: What counts as independent checking. Only a matched checking action is verification-eligible; a report of a check is a reported claim and answers nothing (CONTRACT C5). The saved diagnosis reached checker-object binding zero times because the route demanded a single-token actor; here actor and object are ordinary character spans, so a multiword checker binds like any other value (CORE-STATUS F7).

records.label: explicit_event_reference
records.note: 그 전달을 확인했다 names what was checked.

Three channels, kept apart. OCCURRENCE: whether the checking action happened, taken from the predicate's polarity — occurred or not_performed. RESULT: what the text says the check found, taken only from a declared result form that is structurally attached to the checking construction; a bare 확인했다 leaves it unstated, and a negated check is never denied. INDEPENDENT RESULT: the result as evidence about a particular target.
A check whose occurrence is not_performed produces no verified_by link at all: a check that did not happen is the same epistemic situation as no check, which CONTRACT C5 calls a hold.
Independence is a property of the CHECK and of the TARGET BINDING, not of how the target was first introduced. independent_result_requires therefore asks that the check itself be stated directly rather than inside a report, that a result be explicitly expressed, and that the target binding be unique. A directly evidenced explicit result about an event that a report introduced is independent evidence about that event, and is published while the report's own claim and scope are preserved. A reported check is never independent, and a bare check states no result.
A reference expression can be positive evidence without identifying one target. Where one check reaches more than one target under the same reference, every binding is kept as a candidate — none is asserted — until something distinguishes them.
records.channel_note: checking_outcome is closed over confirmed / denied / unstated and is only ever about a RESULT. A check that did not happen has no result, so its outcome is unstated, not denied and not a value of its own: that the action did not happen is said by checking_occurred = not_performed and by [event, 'polarity', 'false']. Keeping not_performed out of the outcome enumeration stops a consumer reading it as a finding.

result_form_attachment.note: A result form counts only where it is attached to the checking construction: it must begin a chunk, end at a declared boundary form or at the predicate, and not lie inside a span already bound as a role value. Without this a name that merely contains a result form — an object called 사실로재단 — invented a finding. The test is structural and character-exact; no word is blacklisted.
